canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, compact separators, one trailing LF
lock_rule: Canonicalize and hash before RUN_AUTHORIZED. A locked ID/version cannot change.
limited_data_rule: Only EXPLORATORY plus limited_data_non_promotable=true may proceed with failed or unknown required capabilities.
pre_research_review_rule: Every market-research family must bind an exact current owner-reviewed status PDF before preregistration lock. Infrastructure canaries and synthetic governance tests are exempt and remain permanently nonpromotable.
